title: betula papyrifera subsp. neoalaskana
intro: Betula papyrifera subsp. neoalaskana, commonly known as paper birch, is a subspecies of the paper birch tree (Betula papyrifera) native to Alaska. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing fever, inflammation, and pain due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Betula papyrifera subsp. neoalaskana include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, which help to soothe and calm various health issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
